text: Lesson 55.
The Sawyer family.
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
zh: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
zh_hant: 聽錄音，然後回答這個問題。

text: When do the children do their homework?
zh: 孩子们什么时候做作业？
zh_hant: 孩子們什麼時候做作業？

text: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.
zh: 索耶一家住在国王街87号。
zh_hant: 索耶一家住在國王街87號。

text: In the morning,
Mr. Sawyer goes to work and the children go to school.
zh: 索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。
zh_hant: 索耶先生去上班，孩子們去上學。

text: Their father takes them to school every day.
zh: 他们的父亲每天送他们上学。
zh_hant: 他們的父親每天送他們上學。

text: Mrs. Sawyer stays at home every day.
zh: 索耶太太每天待在家里。
zh_hant: 索耶太太每天待在家裡。

text: She does the housework.
She always eats her lunch at noon.
In the afternoon, she usually sees her friends.
zh: 下午，她通常会见她的朋友。
zh_hant: 下午，她通常會見她的朋友。

text: They often drink tea together.
In the evening, the children come home from school.
zh: 晚上，孩子们从学校回家。
zh_hant: 晚上，孩子們從學校回家。

text: They arrive home early.
Mr. Sawyer comes home from work.
He arrives home late.
At night, the children always do their homework.
zh: 夜里，孩子们总是做作业。
zh_hant: 夜裡，孩子們總是做作業。

text: Then they go to bed.
Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper,
but sometimes he and his wife watch television.
zh: 但有时他和他妻子看电视。
zh_hant: 但有時他和他妻子看電視。
